name: Predefined Medicaid MAX-TAF Admissions Datasets
description: Predefined Medicaid MAX-TAF admissions datasets contain outcome-specific Medicaid inpatient admission products derived from harmonized MAX and TAF inpatient claims using configured diagnosis-code, diagnosis-position, and admission-selection rules.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: Predefined Medicaid MAX-TAF Admissions V1 Datasets
description: Outcome-specific Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient admission products covering all states from 2000-2018. Each outcome has its own folder (e.g., mental_health/) containing qualifying admission files and county/ZCTA yearly and daily admission counts, with the outcome definition encoded in the file name as icdset<N>_dx<positions>_<selection> (e.g., admissions_icdset1_dxall_all_yyyy.parquet). State coverage varies during the 2014-2015 MAX-to-TAF transition.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: Mental Health Admissions
description: Mental health Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient admission outcomes. Admission files are named by outcome definition as admissions_icdset<N>_dx<positions>_<selection>_yyyy.parquet; aggregate counts are in <geography>/counts_yyyy.parquet. Current definition: icdset1_dxall_all, where a qualifying admission has a mental health diagnosis code from ICD code set 1 in any diagnosis position (dxall), including all qualifying admissions without readmission exclusions (all). Placeholder definition; code set details to be added.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: Mental Health Qualifying Admissions
description: Beneficiary-admission file containing Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient admissions that meet the icdset1_dxall_all outcome definition, with cohort indicator flags from the denominator.

name: Daily County-Level Outcome Counts
description: Daily County-level counts of mental health qualifying Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient admissions (n_adm__<cohort>) for the `icdset1_dxall_all` definition. Cohorts: total, ffs (fee-for-service all year), dual (dual-eligible all year), disabled (disability-based eligibility all year), full_benefit (full Medicaid benefits all year).
